entities.name: WASF2 (WAVE2)
observations: 500-aa query matches reviewed human WASF2 (UniProt Q9Y6W5) at 80.4% identity and 100% coverage; E-value 1.52e-209.
WASF2 is a WAVE-complex effector that promotes Arp2/3-mediated actin filament reorganization and lamellipodia formation.
Predicted domains: SCAR_helical at residues 3–179 and WH2 at residues 436–461. Localization evidence includes cytoplasm, cytoskeleton, and lamellipodium.
